scope: Read-only semantic review; no cloud inventory, object reads, Registry writes or runtime execution

basis.rule: Preserve historical records, data residency, quota and final-test boundaries

basis.role: Frozen round009 retains explicit original legacy receipt and processing contract
Historical UI metadata only; not current inventory or byte measurements

version_semantics.historical_snapshots_v1: Schema1 strict unique-SID projection; old failed/interrupted configurations remain historical roots. A later v2 directory does not prove v1 bytes are equivalent or unused.
version_semantics.historical_snapshots_v2: Schema2 retains every source occurrence and source_record_index. Duplicate selected field projections are retained evidence, not removable row duplicates.
version_semantics.window_filename_hash: Hash of plan_hash, synthetic flag and window identity; it is not a hash of the completed manifest bytes.
version_semantics.batch_object_filename_hash: Hash of the complete canonical payload, including schema, plan_hash, window, batch_index and records. Same projected financial values in another plan do not establish byte equality.
version_semantics.intents: Persistent source-fetch guard and historical evidence. A completed window can coexist with its original intent because success does not delete it. An unfinished intent intentionally blocks implicit retry.
version_semantics.stable_cache: Current verified_legacy mode follows the pinned original receipt and verifies all original windows/batches. The receipt, window manifests and transitive original data must remain. The newer processing contract does not permit relabeling old rows.
version_semantics.received_reference_manifest: cached_row_reference_v1 holds references to five original price-cache objects; a small new receiver manifest is not a replacement copy of those original price objects.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: v1 is old, therefore remove its approximately2MB folder
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Version and semantics differ; historical failed-source evidence and implicit plan reachability remain unresolved.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: An intent has a matching completed window, therefore delete the intent
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Source implementation retains intents by design; they bind historical dispatch/no-refetch evidence and must not be silently rewritten.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: The task failed or round closed, therefore its cache is unreferenced
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Failed and closed attempts remain historical roots; later verified_legacy consumers can still depend on old completed snapshots.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: Same digest-like basename or rounded size proves duplicate bytes
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Digest roles differ across object types, and path names/rounded sizes do not verify actual contents.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: No local explicit key reference proves a cloud object is orphaned
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Cloud manifests, receipt window_refs, event streams, derived key rules and other project readers can supply unseen edges.

automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.claim: Repeated projection records inside a v2 batch can be deleted
automatic_reclaim_decisions_rejected.reason: Occurrence preservation is frozen source semantics; row removal would alter history and hashes.

candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.category: Unreferenced exact second object copy outside all protected namespaces
conditions: All current and historical reference roots resolved
No implicit schema-derived reference or other-project consumer
Actual full-byte SHA and size equal a retained copy
Not a receipt, manifest, intent, event stream or required failure artifact
candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.reason_for_priority: Could release physical bytes without altering retained identities, if every condition is independently established.

candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.category: Partial-write batch with no completed window manifest
conditions: Resolve associated intent and failed attempt
No inbound reference from any current or historical metadata
candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.reason_for_priority: Potentially larger abandoned writes exist in this storage design, but missing manifest alone is not permission to remove failure evidence.

candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.category: Temporary or legacy duplicate objects whose ownership can be proven
conditions: No reference or historical receipt obligation
Actual bytes and retained equivalent verified where necessary
candidate_categories_in_review_priority_.reason_for_priority: Search outside the protected active/historical snapshot closure before considering any referenced cache. Names such as old or temp are insufficient.

size_statement: The parent observed rounded current UI sizes of approximately2MB for v1 and47MB for v2. This source-only review has not measured or independently re-observed either size; neither entire directory may be counted as reclaimable.
missing_evidence: Complete cloud object list and exact physical byte sizes
Current cloud metadata/reference closure, including other project consumers
Actual byte digests for candidate duplicate pairs
